summary: Muse used its existing approved pair on release code37. Automatic wake, 812 UTF-16-unit text write and four-part exact readback, and a separate 122-character failure-note save/reopen passed. File upload/stat passed; WPS and Notes share dispatch was accepted but receiving-app content delivery was not verified. XHS and Douyin public searches were not executed because their first-use agreements remained unaccepted. This is not a complete cross-app search or file-import acceptance.

scope.actor: Muse actual cloud-side Airtap CLI execution; supplied cloud receipts independently checked offline by maintainer
scope.device: Existing Meizu Note 16 / Android 15 test phone
scope.connection: Existing persistent approved public-relay pair, not new-user onboarding
scope.installation_intervention: Maintainer performed same-signature USB overwrite to code37 before this task, without clearing data or pairing again. Installation is not attributed to Muse.
scope.review_intervention: Read-only archive transfer, offline JSON/hash/image review and separate maintainer package-version query. No reviewer task execution or agreement acceptance.

release.version_basis: Initial and final Muse ping responses
release.apk_hash_boundary: Build/installation metadata from the release maintainer; the evidence archive does not contain an independently downloaded installed APK.

client_materials.verification_boundary: Muse RUNLOG reports downloads and matching digest headers. Downloaded CLI, guide and headers are outside this archive; these reported hashes were not independently established from bundled source files.

evidence_integrity.manifest_exclusion: RECEIPTS.md is the remaining file and does not list its own hash.
evidence_integrity.transfer_chain: Exact maintainer-provided remote archive path was read over the already configured SSH connection. Partial uploads were observed and rejected until the ZIP directory was complete. Completed remote size/SHA were compared with the copied local archive and matched. No Muse message announcing this archive SHA was seen.
evidence_integrity.retained_transfer_failure: One post-copy SSH metadata check returned exit255. A subsequent read succeeded and matched the full local archive.
evidence_integrity.extraction: Offline bounded ZIP validation and CRC/hash extraction; rejected paths, symlinks and special entries; no contained script executed.
evidence_integrity.source_redaction: Muse supplied a sanitized archive, not the byte-identical original execution directory. RECEIPTS reports 194 substitutions for observation/snapshot/request/transfer/share identifiers and matching command flags. Common [REDACTED] placeholders prevent exact original snapshot-ID equality verification.
evidence_integrity.image_boundary: Multiple receipts can refer to the same JPEG. Key direct agreement screenshots, post-Back empty Notes editor, reopened final note and final HOME image are bundled and hash-matched. Missing intermediate images are not counted as visually verified.
evidence_integrity.independence_boundary: Hash checks establish transfer and internal evidence consistency. Supplied cloud-side receipts are not independent relay telemetry or cryptographic proof of actor identity.

older_apps_audio_1105.version: No version ping in this group; not attributed to code37

response_inventory.local_cli_failure: One additional zero-byte JSON file followed a tap invocation missing the required package argument. RUNLOG records argparse exit2, then fresh observation and corrected invocation. It is not a relay response or executed phone action; original stderr is not bundled.
response_inventory.boundary: Response success counts are not task success counts. Older groups remain separate from code37 results.

connection_wake_and_silence.initial_and_final_status: Approved, persistent, all-app control allowed, device connected, no pending request; same connection identifier compared privately. Values omitted.
connection_wake_and_silence.credential_boundary: RUNLOG reports use of the original config, with no new pairing. Same connection identifier and successful status are consistent with reuse; the sanitized archive does not expose original credentials for an independent comparison.
connection_wake_and_silence.wake: Initial ping reported screen_off and device_unlocked=false with auto_wake=true. Initial observe succeeded on launcher and subsequent foreground reported device_unlocked=true.
connection_wake_and_silence.final_state: HOME accepted; final ping ready/unlocked; final foreground is Flyme launcher.
connection_wake_and_silence.audio: Initial/final full audio-state results match exactly. Music volume is0 with muted=false; ring/notification/system are0 and muted=true. Alarm12 and voice-call5 remain unchanged. No audio/volume-changing command appears in the supplied task logs.
connection_wake_and_silence.boundary: This verifies one observed wake and unchanged audio settings, not a fresh long-idle interval, force-stop/reboot recovery or an acoustic recording.

long_text.target: Secondary text field; Primary and Unbound fields remained unchanged in inspected trees
long_text.independent_verification: Concatenated actual result.text from all four read_node_text responses and compared UTF-8 bytes against both bundled original and Muse-spliced files: exact match.
long_text.snapshot_metadata: Package, field, node/window metadata, total length and offsets agree; remaining lifetime decreases. Original snapshot identifiers are redacted to a common placeholder, so exact ID binding is not independently auditable from this copy.
long_text.timing_boundary: Muse measurement reported in verification text; command timestamps are consistent, but no independent monotonic trace is bundled.

file_share.upload: Finish offset/size52, publication_atomic=true, current_stat_sha256 verification; two stat results agree with independently hashed source and each other.
file_share.share_dispatch: WPS and Notes share_file returned accepted=true, read_only=true, text/plain, chooser_requested=true, lifetime300000ms, delivery_verified=false.
file_share.wps: Normal Android open-app confirmation was accepted, followed by WPS showing the synthetic filename and first-use EULA/privacy screen. Neither agreement button was clicked. This proves handoff and filename visibility, not file-content reading.
file_share.notes: Chooser and normal open-app confirmation were followed by an active focused window with root_available=false and secure_capture_state=not_determined. Read-only observations were retried, then Back restored a Notes editor with empty title and0-character body. The imported content was not verified; this attempt does not pass Notes text import.
file_share.recovery: No blind click into the unavailable root. After Back, screenshot/tree were readable; another Back returned to the visible note list. Cause of the inaccessible window and empty import remains undetermined.
file_share.boundary: An accepted share is not proof of receiver consumption. This run neither proves end-to-end file import nor isolates all causes to the receiving App. No external recipient was selected in the supplied logs. Synthetic workspace file was retained.

first_use_agreements.review_boundary: Screenshots and native trees show explicit first-use agreement acceptance, not a plain informational dismissal. No later/skip control or checkbox was visible in these captured screens. Full linked terms pages were not retrieved; tree bodies were truncated. Permission disclosures do not prove permissions were granted.
first_use_agreements.actions: Muse returned HOME without accepting/rejecting these agreements. A subsequent owner decision and follow-up run, if any, require a separate record.

public_search_and_note.reason: XHS and Douyin stopped at first-use agreement screens; no search page or public result reached.
public_search_and_note.verification: New synthetic note states both searches were not performed. Exact full title and122-character body matched the requested text in a settled tree and in the reopened tree, with text_truncated=false. Reopened screenshot independently inspected; native counter also shows122字.
public_search_and_note.retained_transient: The immediate tree after set-body still showed0字/blank body; later settled and reopened trees showed the exact text. Immediate action acceptance alone was not used as completion proof.
public_search_and_note.boundary: Saving an accurate failure note does not count as completing public search/research. Synthetic note was retained. No post, private message, follow, login or account-creation action appears in the supplied logs.

maintainer_package_metadata.method: Separate maintainer read-only ADB package query after the run; not a Muse command receipt

remaining_acceptance: After an explicit owner decision, retry WPS text-content reading and XHS/Douyin public search; preserve any login, permission or compatibility blocker.
Investigate Notes share import separately; direct set-text success does not repair or validate ACTION_SEND text-file import.
Muse traversal of a real interface with more than128 indexed nodes is not covered here; native/host pagination tests remain separate evidence.
This existing-pair maintainer-supported run does not replace independent novice onboarding, other agent/platform compatibility or new long-idle/reconnect acceptance.
Six intermediate screenshots and unredacted snapshot identity are absent; no claim depends on independently viewing those missing artifacts.
privacy: Only synthetic content sizes/hashes, outcome metadata and agreement-screen labels are published. No raw archive, screenshots, credentials, device identifiers, connection IDs, hostnames or private evidence paths are committed.
